name: 3-sliced
description: Lane 03 published this spec's tickets; the build runs on them, not on it

name: waiting
description: A ticket behind an open blocker; the reconciler starts it when the blocker delivers

name: queued
description: A ticket with every blocker delivered and no worker slot yet

name: sliceable
description: A spec lane 02 handed to lane 03 to slice

name: needs-human
description: Ticket stalled; a human decision or action is required

name: fuzzy
description: A decision is owed before this can be ticketed

name: by-hand
description: Claims a workstation, cross-repo, or immutable-set path; a human builds it by hand

name: 1-decide
description: The shaper posted its decision sheet and waits for approved, killed or parked

name: 2-questions-open
description: The spec carries open questions; the owner's edit is what moves it

name: slice-failed
description: A to-tickets run refused or failed

name: shape-refused
description: Refused at lane 01 stage 1: the idea already exists, or an ADR ruled it

name: spec/gap
description: The spec is silent, ambiguous or self-contradictory here

name: to-build
description: The owner hands a finished ticket straight to the build; swapped for the lane label at dispatch

name: to-spec

name: killed

description: Shaped and set down. No dispatch, and nothing ever re-raises it
